Indian Army SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027 Online Form - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Army (Govt. Of India) has released short notice for the SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027 Batch Recruitment on the official website of Indian Army. Online applying process for Indian Army SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027 Recruitment will start from 09 July 2026 & the candidates can apply till 07 August 2026. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the Indian Army SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027 Recruitment. Candidates must check the complete details for Indian Army SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027 Recruitment which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 July 2026
  • Last Date : 07 August 2026
  • Course Start on : April 2027

Application Fee

  • No application fee is required to apply for the Indian Army SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Indian Army SSC Technical 68th Men April 2027 Online Form is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 07 August 2026.
